findings.title: Gate only the option lists required by the selected operation
findings.problem: For mode=search-existing with a valid candidate such as {id:10, existingPath:'/tv/show'}, an unavailable root-folder, quality-profile, or tag list now disables Confirm. These lists are not required for the supported search-only operation: hasRequiredOptions explicitly exempts it, and the backend's search-existing branch uses only the candidate ID. Likewise, an add with no selected tags is blocked by unavailable tags even though backend validation permits it. Partial dependency failure unnecessarily disables otherwise usable operations.

findings.title: Stop relay failover after an uncertain submission
findings.problem: With two configured clients, client A can accept an NZB but delay its response past the new deadline. RELAY_SUBMISSION_UNKNOWN only sets a flag, so the loop submits the same files to client B and returns B's success. Both clients can download the release. This is newly reachable for slow successful requests that previously remained pending. Additionally, ordinary external NZBs enter through a structured parser rejection, so the !wasStructured guard suppresses FORWARD_UNCONFIRMED when no subsequent client succeeds.

members.title: Relay loop keeps submitting to the next app after an outcome-unknown timeout (duplicate submission)

members.fix_hint: Break out of the loop once a submission's outcome is unknown.

members.problem: After RELAY_SUBMISSION_UNKNOWN the loop submits to the next client, which contradicts the CHANGELOG promise that writes are never auto-retried after an unknown outcome.
members.why_it_matters: Duplicate downloads.
members.fix_hint: Break out of the loop on RELAY_SUBMISSION_UNKNOWN.

findings.title: Handle search-existing deadline expiry as an uncertain write
findings.problem: The newly added signal cancels a SeriesSearch POST after the deadline even if Sonarr already accepted it. The search-existing caller at ArrDiscoveryHandoffService.ts:251-257 supplies no signal and has no uncertainty handler, so cancellation reaches the generic ARR_HANDOFF_FAILED response at line 267. BrowseProgrammePage then advertises retry and never sets requiresReconfirmation. A slow accepted search can therefore be immediately submitted again. The same issue affects MoviesSearch.

findings.title: Handle search-existing deadline expiry as an uncertain write
findings.problem: The newly added signal cancels a SeriesSearch POST after the deadline even if Sonarr already accepted it. The search-existing caller at ArrDiscoveryHandoffService.ts:251-257 supplies no signal and has no uncertainty handler, so cancellation reaches the generic ARR_HANDOFF_FAILED response at line 267. BrowseProgrammePage then advertises retry and never sets requiresReconfirmation. A slow accepted search can therefore be immediately submitted again. The same issue affects MoviesSearch.
